Package logic.game

Class GameBoard

java.lang.Object
logic.game.GameBoard
public class GameBoard extends Object
Represents the game board (map) for a single level. Parses a text-based map file from resources and stores walls, obstacles, cables, items, enemies, the player start position, and the exit door position. Provides lookup methods for finding objects at specific grid coordinates.

    • fromResource

      public static GameBoard fromResource(String resourcePath)
      Loads and parses a map file from the classpath. Each character in the text file represents a tile (wall, floor, enemy, item, etc.).
      Parameters:
      resourcePath - the classpath resource path to the map file
      Returns:
      the parsed GameBoard
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the file cannot be found, read, or contains invalid data
